title: Kevin Day radar objects at 28,000 ft matched in data

tellings.quote: So, um Kevin Day said that these objects were at 28,000 ft.

plain: During a 2004 Navy encounter with unknown objects off Southern California, a man named Kevin Day reported that the objects were at 28,000 feet, and according to the story, the data backs up that height. A guest named Marik von Rennenkampff repeats Day's account on an episode about challenging the skeptic Mick West to a debate: "Kevin Day said that these objects were at 28,000 ft." He also mentions a man named Chad Underwood, who filmed the event with an infrared camera. Matching the reported height in the data would mean the objects were real things high in the sky, not tricks of the camera.
